title: Social posts shorten team names correctly
items: Post captions, graphics and videos drop the mascot from team names. A few came out wrong, such as 'Marquette Golden' for Marquette Golden Eagles, 'Army Black' for Army Black Knights, and Cincinnati keeping 'Bearcats'. The longest matching mascot now wins, and a leftover word like 'Golden' or 'Black' goes with it.
Schools whose mascot is not on the list keep their full name rather than being cut short.
